about.label: About
about.title: About me
about.description: JavaScript/TypeScript developer focused on React, Next.js, and React Native, building performant, accessible, and well-crafted interfaces.
about.headline: Software Engineer · Frontend & Mobile
about.bio: I'm a JavaScript/TypeScript developer working mainly with React, Next.js, and React Native. I like building clear, fast, well-crafted interfaces without losing sight of APIs, authentication, operations, and real-world use. I've worked on AI-powered apps, high-traffic platforms, and evolving products of my own.

craft.title: Product work with strong interface craft
craft.description: In Apollo App and other products, I worked where UX, business rules, and implementation had to move together. My best work usually happens at the edge between interface, flow, and delivery.

taste.title: Scale without losing finish
taste.description: At WeFit and on projects for Azul Airlines and Rede Americas, I worked on products large enough to demand stability, clarity, and delivery speed without giving up visual care.

evolving.title: Craft with responsibility
evolving.description: Beyond implementation, I take part in design systems, code reviews, and frontend implementation decisions so the interface stays good after the first version ships.

experience.title: Work experience
experience.description: Teams and companies where I've worked as a developer.

superAdega.description: I actively participated in the development of an internal corporate intranet project focused on centralizing and optimizing the company's internal processes. I worked alongside the IT team, directors, and collaborators from various departments to map real business needs and transform them into efficient technological solutions. The system was adopted across all company areas, integrating administrative and operational workflows into a single platform.
achievements: 100% improvement in company workflow, with direct gains in productivity and internal communication
Project recognized and awarded by TOTVS for innovation and outstanding results
Intranet adopted across all company departments in a single integrated platform
Business needs mapping in collaboration with IT, directors, and cross-functional teams

moonxi.description: I worked on full stack web and mobile product development at Moonxi. On Join, a community app built on trust and 2nd-degree connections, I contributed to the mobile experience for discovering events and plans within the user's trusted circle. On Apollo App, the mobile client for the Apollo Space AI workspace, I built with Expo and React Native a daily operational hub: Home briefing, AI agent chat (streaming), team messaging, kanban boards with tasks and comments, Google Calendar integration, and profile with notifications, all aligned with the web product.
achievements: Join: mobile community app where members discover plans and events from their trusted circle
Apollo App: mobile operational hub with AI chat, kanban, calendar, and briefing (Digital Twin, tasks, finance)
Amazon Cognito authentication and FastAPI REST API integration on the Apollo mobile client
Multi-view calendar module with Google Calendar to create, edit, and send email invites
pt-BR/en i18n and light/dark themes, with v1.0.0 beta shipped on Expo SDK 54

wefit.description: I worked as a front-end developer on several large-scale projects, including B2B and B2C solutions for prominent clients such as Azul Airlines and Rede Américas (Amil and Dasa). I became a technical reference in documentation and best practices, especially regarding Firebase in React and Next.js applications, and was recognized for my mastery of animations with Styled-Components, Keyframes, and TypeScript. I also organized and led multiple simultaneous projects, with direct client contact, code reviews, and agile methodologies such as SCRUM.
achievements: Azul Cargo: platform supporting thousands of simultaneous accesses with high performance and stability
Internal logistics and operational control systems focused on stability and UX
Internal technical reference for Firebase, React, Next.js, and documentation best practices
Recognized for mastery of animations with Styled-Components, Keyframes, and TypeScript
Led multiple simultaneous projects with deliveries aligned to business objectives

projects.label: Projects
projects.title: Featured projects
projects.description: A selection of products, apps, and platforms I worked on with a focus on frontend, mobile, and user experience.

biotree.subtitle: Links for businesses
biotree.description: A link platform for businesses where your bio link becomes a branded showcase, ready for Instagram, WhatsApp, and whatever matters most.
biotree.longDescription: Biotree is the platform I'm building for businesses to turn a bio link into a complete digital presence. In a single link, the brand gets its own showcase, aligned with its visual identity and ready for Instagram, WhatsApp, and the channels that matter most.
responsibilities: Product design and full-stack development of the Biotree platform
Building the branded link showcase experience
Architecting a one-link digital presence for businesses
Ongoing product evolution focused on usability and conversion
results: Live platform at biotree.com.br
Bio link as a branded showcase
Product in active development for businesses

azul.subtitle: B2B & B2C digital solutions
azul.description: Front-end development of large-scale solutions for Azul Airlines, including public logistics products and internal operations systems, focused on performance, stability, and UX.
azul.longDescription: At Azul Airlines, I worked on front-end for large-scale B2B and B2C solutions. On Azul Cargo, I contributed to a public logistics platform built for high concurrency, performance, and stability. I also worked on internal logistics and operational control systems, with care for interface clarity and day-to-day robustness — without exposing confidential process details.
responsibilities: Front-end development of large-scale B2B and B2C solutions for Azul Airlines
Built the Azul Cargo platform focused on performance and stability under high concurrency
Evolved internal logistics and operational control systems
Interface and UX work on enterprise-scale products
Project organization, client contact, code reviews, and SCRUM
results: Azul Cargo sustaining thousands of concurrent accesses with high performance
Internal operations systems with clearer, more stable day-to-day use
Front-end deliveries aligned to performance, UX, and scale

rede.subtitle: Healthcare network sites & systems
rede.description: I built institutional websites for Rede Américas hospitals (Madre Theodora, Pró-Cardíaco, Samaritano, Maternidade Brasília, and Santa Joana Recife), plus other public portals and support for internal operations systems.
rede.longDescription: At Rede Américas, I developed institutional websites for leading hospital units, including Hospital Madre Theodora, Hospital Pró-Cardíaco, Hospital Samaritano, Maternidade Brasília, and Hospital Santa Joana Recife. I also created other public network portals and supported maintenance and evolution of internal systems used in unit day-to-day work, without detailing operational flows or data.
responsibilities: Front-end development of large-scale B2B and B2C solutions for Rede Américas (Amil and Dasa)
Organization and leadership of multiple simultaneous projects with direct client contact
Code reviews and agile methodologies (SCRUM)
Documentation and best practices for React, Next.js, and Firebase
results: Digital sites and systems delivered for Rede Américas units
Technical reference for documentation, Firebase, React, and Next.js
High-quality deliveries aligned with business objectives

apollo.subtitle: AI agent workspace
apollo.description: Mobile client for Apollo Space AI: a daily operational hub with AI agent chat, kanban, calendar, and briefing, aligned with the web product.
apollo.longDescription: On Apollo App, the mobile client for the Apollo Space AI workspace (Moonxi), I built with Expo and React Native a daily operational hub: Home briefing, streaming AI agent chat, team messaging, kanban boards with tasks and comments, Google Calendar integration, and profile with notifications. Amazon Cognito authentication and FastAPI REST API, with pt-BR/en i18n and light/dark themes. v1.0.0 beta shipped on Expo SDK 54.
responsibilities: Built the Apollo mobile client with Expo, React Native, and TypeScript
Streaming AI agent chat, team messaging, and kanban boards
Google Calendar integration (create, edit, invites) and Home briefing
Amazon Cognito authentication and FastAPI REST API consumption
pt-BR/en i18n, light/dark themes, and v1.0.0 beta delivery
results: Mobile operational hub aligned with the Apollo Space AI web product
AI chat, kanban, calendar, and briefing (Digital Twin, tasks, finance)
v1.0.0 beta published on Expo SDK 54

rdm.subtitle: Assembly, locks, and repairs in Brasília
rdm.description: Local-services landing page focused on fast response, visual proof of work, and direct WhatsApp quoting.
rdm.longDescription: For RDM Serviços, I worked on a local-conversion landing page: clear service offer, visual proof of work, Brasília coverage, and a low-friction quoting flow. The communication reinforces speed, trust, and direct contact with Robson himself instead of generic service language.
responsibilities: Structured the landing page around fast quote requests
Organized services, coverage area, and recent work into a clear offer
Built the contact flow around WhatsApp
Directed concise copy for a local service business
results: Live website with a direct quote CTA
Clear service offer for visitors in Brasília and nearby areas
Real work samples reinforcing trust before contact

mindline.subtitle: Psychology and mental health clinic
mindline.description: Institutional landing page with a welcoming tone, trust-first structure, and clear paths to booking and contact.
mindline.longDescription: For Mindline, the work revolves around warmth, clarity, and reassurance on the first visit. The landing page organizes benefits, team, space, warning signs, FAQ, and contact in a way that is more sensitive to the mental-health context while keeping booking as the main destination.
responsibilities: Structured an institutional landing page for the clinic
Organized content to build trust from the first screen
Directed warmer, less clinical copy
Created clearer paths to booking and contact
results: Live site focused on credibility and care
Team, space, and benefits explained with clarity
Contact and booking placed at the center of the journey

ektos.subtitle: Solidarity teaching project
ektos.description: A solidarity project offering free programming education for anyone interested in learning to code.
ektos.longDescription: Éktos was a solidarity project created to teach programming completely free of charge to anyone interested. The goal was to democratize access to knowledge and open doors for people wanting to start in tech, at no cost and with accessible content.
responsibilities: Planned and structured programming teaching content
Taught classes and supported participants' learning journeys
Created accessible learning materials for beginners
Organized the project with a focus on inclusion and free access
results: 100% free programming education for interested learners
Democratized access to technology knowledge
Built a foundation for people entering the field

recommendations.label: Recommendations
recommendations.title: What teammates say
recommendations.description: Recommendations from people I've worked with.

eduardo.name: Eduardo Rodrigues
eduardo.quote: Working with Lucas was a very positive experience that I'll always keep as a reference. As a front-end developer, he consistently showed technical mastery, attention to detail, and commitment to delivery quality, staying true to the proposed design. As a Product Designer, we had a collaborative partnership where it was easy to discuss solutions, align expectations, and make sure the user experience was considered from start to finish. Communication with Lucas is clear and light, which helped keep an efficient workflow. On top of that, his good humor and professional posture made day-to-day work more enjoyable. Without a doubt, a valuable professional on any team.

mario.name: Mario Lima
mario.quote: I've had the pleasure of working with Lucas since he joined our team in May of last year (2024), and it's been amazing to watch his growth. From day one, he's been proactive, taking on new tasks with real enthusiasm and always looking for ways to help the team. He's quick to learn new technologies and isn't afraid to roll up his sleeves to find solutions that improve the project. His positive attitude and willingness to go the extra mile have made a real difference in our team's success. I'm confident that wherever he goes next, he'll bring the same passion and commitment he's shown here.

carlos.name: Carlos Dória
carlos.quote: I worked with Lucas for 6 months as a Front-end developer and could see his proactivity and organization. He was always available to take on new requests and help the work move forward. In dailies and reviews, he stood out for how clearly he handled requests and for the care he took documenting everything in progress. He's a responsible, collaborative professional who would add a lot to any team.
